request.description: Routes a lead now (the worker also does this when a lead is captured, qualified, recycled or gets consent). `outcome`: `offered`, `already_assigned`, `consent_pending`, `not_routable`, `no_rule`, `manual_rule`, `no_candidate` or `offer_limit_reached`; every outcome except `already_assigned` and `not_routable` is written to the lead timeline. An offer expires at `respondBy` and the lead moves to the next CA. Only leads that are `new` or `qualified`, have consent status `ok` and no active offer are routed. The first matching published rule picks verified, active, unpaused CAs that may receive the lead (partner sharing consent for that CA, service area, capabilities, free capacity), skipping CAs that already declined, missed or returned this lead. Staff only, lead update access (ops lead, ops reviewer).
